subject: general
question: Which of the following is **true **about relay races?

options.text: A relay team has 6 members, with 4 running members.
The baton exchange zone is 50 meters long.
The baton must weigh exactly 100 grams.
The length of the baton is 10-12 cm.

solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• A relay race team consists of **6 members in total**, out of which **4 are running members**. The additional members typically serve as substitutes or reserves for the team. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.* 

• The baton exchange zone in relay races is **20 meters long**, not 50 meters. This is a standard rule in athletics to ensure fair exchanges between runners. *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.* 

• The baton used in relay races must weigh between **50 to 60 grams**, not exactly 100 grams. This weight is standardized to ensure ease of handling during the race. *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.* 

• The length of the baton is **28-30 cm**, much longer than 10-12 cm. This ensures that the baton is visible and easy to pass during the exchange. Hence, statement 4
